title: Multi-File Data Consolidation
prompt:
Combine several monthly sales files into one dataset.

Skills: Power Query and append operations.

Use the supplied synthetic CSV at assets/data/practical-14-multi-file-data-consolidation.csv. A small copy/pastable sample is included below in case the CSV is not directly downloadable from the lesson page. Complete the work in a separate .xlsx copy, preserve a raw-data sheet, and check the result against the acceptance criteria. Then answer the short grading check; it does not validate the workbook itself.

Sample CSV (synthetic):
OrderID,OrderDate,Region,Amount
O2001,2026-01-05,East,250
O2002,2026-01-12,West,430
O2003,2026-02-02,East,180
O2004,2026-02-17,North,510
objective: Combine several monthly sales files into one dataset.

options: Append vertically aligned monthly records after confirming common column names and data types.
Append requires different columns for every file.
Overwrite all source files with one output.

expected_output: Expected: same-schema source files are appended, data types remain consistent, source names are traceable and record counts reconcile.

public_tests.name: Sample-data acceptance
checklist: Input records are preserved and data types are checked.
Totals/results reconcile with a small independent calculation.
An edge case, duplicate or threshold boundary is tested where relevant.

public_tests.name: Server-side answer check
public_tests.note: A text/choice check does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook artifact.

acceptance_criteria: Expected: same-schema source files are appended, data types remain consistent, source names are traceable and record counts reconcile.
Use a labeled result area and document formulas, assumptions or transformation steps.
Compare actual results with a manual/independently calculated expected result and test one edge case.
Keep source data intact and request human review of the completed workbook; do not treat the text grader as artifact validation.
hints: Import data without losing dates, decimals or leading zeros.
Separate raw inputs, calculations and presentation outputs.
Test empty inputs, duplicated keys, boundary values or missing matches as appropriate to the scenario.

grading_config.correct_answer: Append vertically aligned monthly records after confirming common column names and data types.

grading_method: Server-side choice check of the submitted answer/expression only; does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook. This workbook-practice task needs a human-reviewed artifact and test evidence for full acceptance. Power Query append combines rows from tables with compatible schemas; verify type consistency and row counts after refresh.
retry_policy: Retries are permitted. A failed string/choice submission does not complete the exercise. Course files do not define XP; platform-wide server logic applies.
